audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks 'GNAR!' as the cooldown that gates every engage. GNAR! is the Mega ultimate (90/60/30s) and is not what stops your combo in lane; Mega's Wallop (W, 7s flat) is the stun that cancels the E recast, and Hop (E, 22s at rank 1) is his only escape from your all-in.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Mega Gnar rears up and smashes down, stunning enemies in an area; Riot's E text: Gnar leaps and bounces off units. The transform itself is driven by the Rage bar, which has no cooldown to track at all.
audit.corrected: Difficulty rewritten around the rage bar, Wallop's 7s stun and Hop's 22s escape; GNAR! kept only where it actually matters, as the wall-stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Gnar at 2/10 while whys[4] says 'neither side owns it', and 2+ items read Gnar at 2/10 while whys[6] says your Trinity remount sustain out-bullies him. Both rows also contradicted the mirror, which has already flipped them.
audit.why: The mirror audit states 2+ items was flipped to Kled at 4/10 on Gnar's side and Level 6 to Skill at 5/10, with Levels 1-3 left to Gnar and Levels 4-5 / First item left Skill. The packet chart also gives 2+ items to Kled.
audit.corrected: Row 4 flipped to Skill (5/10) and row 6 to Kled (6/10, the inverse of the mirror's 4/10), in matched full/content pairs, with both whys rewritten so the prose stops contradicting the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer wrote 'Beartrap'; the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope. dontsFull[2] blames 'Mega-E' for the wall interaction — Crunch (E) has no stun; it is GNAR! (R) that throws you and stuns anything that hits a wall. The content layer also attributes a knockup to Wallop, which stuns rather than knocks up.
audit.why: Riot's R text: Mega Gnar throws everything around him in a chosen direction, and any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage. Riot's Mega W text stuns in an area. Kled's E is a dash out with a recast dash back, so a stun landing between the two halves strands you.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, the wall-stun correctly attributed to GNAR! in the don'ts, Wallop's 7s stun named as the combo-canceller in the cooldowns, do's, report[5] and spikes[2].
